infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: WeNitro uses selected photos and videos only when you choose to publish a profile photo, vibe, story, community image, or message attachment.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: WeNitro uses the camera only when you choose to capture media for your profile or a post.

plugins.photosPermission: Allow WeNitro to access only the photos and videos you choose for your profile, stories, communities, Vibes, and chat attachments.
plugins.cameraPermission: Allow WeNitro to use the camera only when you choose to capture a profile photo or other media.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Allow WeNitro to use your location while you choose a nearby activity or your current meeting location.
